cash_conversion_cycle.formula:
((this.inventory(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.inventory(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d
 + ((this.accounts_receivable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.accounts_receivable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d
 - ((this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d

cost_of_revenue.formula:
otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:CostOfRevenue", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"))

days_payable_outstanding.formula: ((this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.accounts_payable(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) / this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 365 d

gross_margin.formula: (this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) - this.cost_of_revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year)) / this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) * 100 percent

net_income.formula:
otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:ProfitLoss", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"))

reported.formula:
let acc = this.annual_report(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) in
this.fact_in(concept: concept, unit: unit, accession: acc, period_end: mesh-test.datumesh.com/relay/sec.gov/filing/period_end(accession: acc), period_kind: period_kind)

return_on_assets.formula: this.net_income(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) / ((this.total_assets(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) + this.total_assets(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / 2) * 100 percent

revenue.formula:
otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:Revenues", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:SalesRevenueGoodsNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 otherwise(this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:SalesRevenueServicesNet", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual"),
 this.reported(concept: "us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense", unit: "USD", fiscal_year: fiscal_year, period_kind: "annual")))))))

revenue_growth.formula: (this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year) - this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) / abs(this.revenue(fiscal_year: fiscal_year - 1)) * 100 percent

label: SEC company (one figure per cik, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one company, keyed by its cik (10 digits). Its stored method fact relays one figure as filed, of one annual report (accession) and period; the cells of the class are the figures of the companies in scope.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros

label: Company figure as filed (XBRL fact, one filing)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one figure as the company filed it in one annual report (accession), exactly as filed: no scaling, no sign change, not normalised. A figure restated in a later annual report is a separate cell with that report's accession. The unit is the unit as filed (a currency code such as USD, shares, <currency>/shares or pure) and is returned as the unit of the value. Only 10-K and 10-K/A reports for fiscal years 2019 to 2024, and the listed concepts; each figure is one cell per filing and period. An instant (a balance) has the same date as period_start and period_end.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.concept: the element as filed with its prefix, such as us-gaap:Assets or dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (see the dictionary)
args.unit: the unit as filed: a currency code such as USD or EUR, shares, <currency>/shares such as USD/shares, or pure
args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
args.period_start: YYYY-MM-DD, the start of the period; an instant has the same date as period_end
args.period_end: YYYY-MM-DD, the end of the period (for an instant, the same date as period_start)

concept.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
concept.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

concept.label: Accounts Payable, Current
concept.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concept.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concept.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

concept.label: Assets
concept.description: Assets (description)

concept.label: Assets, Current
concept.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concept.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
concept.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

concept.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
concept.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concept.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
concept.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

concept.label: Cost of Revenue
concept.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

concept.label: Deposits
concept.description: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

concept.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
concept.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

concept.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concept.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concept.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concept.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concept.label: Goodwill
concept.description: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concept.label: Gross Profit
concept.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

concept.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concept.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concept.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concept.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concept.label: Interest Expense
concept.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

concept.label: Interest Income (Expense), Net
concept.description: The net amount of operating interest income (expense).

concept.label: Inventory, Net
concept.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concept.label: Liabilities
concept.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

concept.label: Liabilities and Equity
concept.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concept.label: Liabilities, Current
concept.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concept.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concept.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concept.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
concept.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concept.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concept.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concept.label: Noninterest Expense
concept.description: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

concept.label: Noninterest Income
concept.description: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

concept.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concept.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concept.label: Payments of Dividends
concept.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

concept.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
concept.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concept.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concept.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concept.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concept.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concept.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
concept.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

concept.label: Research and Development Expense
concept.description: The aggregate costs incurred (1) in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or (2) to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, including the costs of developing computer software up to the point in time of achieving technological feasibility, and costs allocated in accounting for a business combination to in-process projects deemed to have no alternative future use.

concept.label: Revenues
concept.description: Revenues (description)

concept.label: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
concept.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

concept.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent
concept.description: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

concept.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concept.description: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.

concept.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
concept.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one annual report (10-K or 10-K/A), keyed by its accession; its six methods are the report's cik, form, filed date, fiscal year, fiscal period and period end, each as filed in the company's submissions record.

label: The company's CIK (filing, as filed)

label: The form of the report (filing, as filed)

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The filing date (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the date the report was filed, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

label: The fiscal year of the report (filing, as filed)

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The fiscal period of the report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the fiscal period of the report (FY for an annual report), of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: The period end of the report (filing, as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the period end of the report's annual statements; not a cover-page date, which is later, of one annual report (accession), as filed in the company's submissions record; one cell per annual report of the companies in scope.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106

label: SEC company (Datumesh views over the SEC relay)
description: A subclass of the SEC relay's company class, one company per cik: its figures as filed (fact, inherited from the relay), the annual report of a fiscal year (our selection), the companies in scope, the company by its name or ticker, and the ratios and money views. Labels ignore case and extra spaces.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros

label: Latest annual report of a fiscal year (our selection)
description: Datumesh's selection over the SEC's filings, not relayed: the accession of the latest-filed annual report (10-K or 10-K/A) of a company's fiscal year (fy as filed, not the period's year). A later amendment wins; a tie on the filing date goes to the higher accession. A fact about the filings, not a figure; stored by the operator with no source.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.fiscal_year: the fiscal year as filed, a number such as 2023 (unit 1)

label: Company loaded in this run (its figures are in scope)
description: Datumesh's list of the companies whose figures are in the scope of this run: true for each of them, and for no other company. It is the extent of the class sec/company (the companies it lists). A fact about the scope, primary, with no source.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros

label: Company by its name or ticker
description: Datumesh's lookup of a company by a label as the SEC lists it in company_tickers_exchange.json: the company's name, each of its tickers, and a short name (the name without its legal-form words). Labels ignore case and extra spaces (each is folded: lower case, NFC, single spaces); keys stay strict. A label that names more than one company is not in the lookup. The value is the key of that company in sec/company.

args.label: a name or a ticker as the SEC lists it; case and extra spaces are ignored
